bug.actual_behavior: Pandoc is extracted successfully, but the wrapper searches for a bin subdirectory and reports that the binary was not found.
evidence: Extracted binary exists under pandoc-version/pandoc-version/pandoc.exe, while the wrapper expects pandoc-version/bin/pandoc.
bug.expected_behavior: After downloading and extracting the Windows pandoc archive, the wrapper should locate pandoc.exe and continue rendering.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py on Windows when pandoc is absent from PATH.
Allow the wrapper to download and extract pandoc 3.8.3.
bug.summary: Windows pandoc zip layout is incompatible with the bootstrap path assumption
bug.workaround: Add the actual extracted pandoc directory to PATH and rerun with --no-install.
